definitions.explanation: An intersection where one road ends by meeting another at a right angle, forming a T shape. Named after the kanji 丁, which resembles the letter T.

examples.japanese: {丁字路|ていじろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。

examples.english: If you go left at the T-junction up ahead, you'll reach the station.

examples.japanese: {丁字路|ていじろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一時|いちじ}{停止|ていし}→一時停止：05401_ichijiteishi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: T-junctions often have poor visibility, so please stop and check both directions.

notes:
USAGE:
Also commonly written and said as T{字路|じろ} (using the Roman letter T). Both forms are widely understood. Appears frequently in driving directions and traffic regulations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丁字路|ていじろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (to turn at a T-junction)
- {丁字路|ていじろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}しかかる (to come to a T-junction)
- {丁字路|ていじろ}⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧ (T-junction intersection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{十字路|じゅうじろ}→十字路：09387_juujiro⟧: crossroads — a four-way intersection
- ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧: intersection — the general term for any intersection
